note: First verdict 2026-09-29. The row's sentence is the lead-in to the §4.10 figure, the only statement of the Peer Up layout, so the obligation judged is that figure: Local Address (16), Local Port, Remote Port, Sent OPEN, Received OPEN after the per-peer header (Information TLVs are RFC7854-x-19, the OPEN contents RFC7854-x-8). Positive rfc7854_message_layout_test.go::TestRFC7854PeerUpIsThePerPeerHeaderThenTheFixedFieldsAndBothOPENs reads each field raw at its offset from writePeerUp output and the exact total length. Negative ::TestRFC7854PeerUpShorterThanItsFixedFieldsIsRefused: a valid Peer Up is accepted, the same cut 10 octets into the fixed fields is refused (decodePeerUp short check).
